      "name": "mempool",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Only updates test/functional/mempool_accept.py to reflect deserialization behavior; does not touch mempool policy, validation acceptance, or mempool structures.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Does not alter mempool acceptance logic or policy rules."
    },
    {
      "name": "p2p",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Modifies src/net_processing.cpp and blockencodings, altering peer message handling and drop-versus-disconnect behavior for malformed blocks and transactions.",
      "band": "P2",
      "score": 0.7,
      "reason_tag": "DoS protection",
      "rationale": "Early rejection of malformed transactions and blocks closes a serious P2P resource exhaustion vector. Without these checks, an attacker could send a 4 MB block containing roughly 400,000 zero-input/zero-output transactions or 16M weight in non-witness transactions, forcing large memory allocations and CPU overhead before validation drops them."
    },
    {
      "name": "tests",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Changes unit, fuzz, and functional tests solely to exercise and adapt to transaction deserialization changes rather than improving test framework infrastructure.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "test coverage",
      "rationale": "Test modifications are downstream updates covering area-specific serialization changes."
    },
    {
      "name": "utils",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Substantially modifies src/serialize.h by introducing stateful stream parameters (HasSerState, ParamsStream::GetState()) into the serialization framework.",
      "band": "P2",
      "score": 0.65,
      "reason_tag": "new feature",
      "rationale": "Extends the core serialization framework with stateful stream parameters to allow context-aware streaming checks. This provides clean infrastructure for streaming accounting such as cumulative block weight limits without breaking streaming abstractions."
    },
    {
      "name": "validation",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Touches src/primitives/transaction.h to check caps during deserialization, but does not alter consensus rules, block validation logic, or chainstate management in src/validation.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "DoS protection",
      "rationale": "Does not substantively modify validation code or consensus validity rules; it only rejects transactions earlier in the deserialization pipeline."
    }
  ],

  }
}
